allow_instructions: Allow curl for HTTP checks against local development APIs and stack health endpoints.
Allow Docker inspection, project image builds, and project Compose start, stop, restart, build, logs, config, and up operations without privileged mode or destructive volume removal.
Allow corepack, mvn, ./mvnw, and pnpm for local compile, test, verify, lint, typecheck, format, and development server commands, but not deploy, release, or package publishing.
Allow cat, echo, head, ls, rg, seq, sleep, true, and find for local inspection and short waits. Allow exit and break to stop a shell or loop.
block_instructions: Require approval for docker rm, docker rmi, docker system prune, docker volume rm, docker compose down with volumes, privileged containers, host-network containers, or mounting sensitive host directories.
Require approval for find -delete, find -exec, and other find invocations that modify or remove files.
